title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:
S03 E03 — Stalked in Terror

The team uncovers a potential Bigfoot kill zone directly above Lake Fear; thrilled by their findings, they launch a squadron of patrol drones to sweep the area.

description:

title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:

Russell finds fresh clues along an abandoned railroad track, while Ronny and Mireya experience a hotbed of unexplained sounds deep in the forest; Bryce learns new information about the history of Bigfoot in Northern California.

title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:

title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:

title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:

Visibly shaken Ronny and Mireya want answers about the unexplained activity they encountered the night before, while Bryce is baffled by some lights on the security camera; the expedition takes a turn when a team member goes missing.

title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:
S03 E13 — A Massive Discovery
The team pulls out all the stops to corner Bigfoot; Mireya travels on horseback to find evidence; Ronny recruits a psychic specialist to hone in on the creature; Russell catches sight of what could be real proof of Bigfoot.

title: Expedition Bigfoot
description:
